homePage.title: Full-stack Software Engineer
homePage.description: Hi, I’m Yago. This is the place where I overcomplicate simple things just to show I can code them. Explore my projects, check my stack, and see what happens when I have too much free time and a text editor.

aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.message: I’m Yago, { age }, currently based in { address }. I specialize in turning coffee into code and when I’m not staring at a dark theme IDE, I like to play guitar;read books;create codes;play video games;watch movies. I’m definitely better at writing functions than writing bios, so let’s stick to the tech.
aboutMe.experience: It all started at { age }, when I realized those 'colorful letters' on a black screen actually did cool stuff. Since then, I’ve been on a self-taught journey through the endless void of software development. Over the years, I’ve swapped generic tutorials for complex documentation, gaining real-world experience across the full stack. I learn fast, break things occasionally, and always aim to fix them better than they were before.

skills.title: Skills & Stack
skills.description: My arsenal of languages and tools

frontend.title: Frontend Development
frontend.description: Building pixel-perfect interfaces that look good even on Internet Explorer (just kidding, I have standards). I turn Figma designs into responsive code and I actually know how to center a div.

backend.title: Backend Engineering
backend.description: The heavy lifting behind the scenes. I build scalable APIs, secure authentication flows, and business logic that keeps the server from crashing on Friday afternoons.

devops.title: DevOps & Cloud Infra
devops.description: Taking code from 'localhost:3000' to the real world. I handle CI/CD pipelines, Docker containers, and AWS instances so that 'it works on my machine' becomes 'it works everywhere'.

database.title: Database Architecture
database.description: Structuring data efficiently so queries don't take 3 business days to run. Experience with SQL and NoSQL, and I promise never to run a DELETE without a WHERE clause.

quality.title: Code Quality & Testing
quality.description: Writing clean, maintainable code that my future self won't hate. I believe in testing (mostly) and refactoring spaghetti code until it looks like a gourmet pasta dish.
